## Goal
Add an offline guard that builds a synthetic 400-broker registry in `tmp_path` and runs registry load, the exposure scan with a fake instant fetcher, matching and the score over it. It counts operations and fetches instead of measuring time, so it is stable on slow CI.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Registry load, scan, match and score complete for 400 brokers with a fake fetcher.
2. Fetch count equals the number of distinct requests (no accidental N-squared fetching); matcher call count is linear in listings.
3. Peak result memory is bounded: a generous object-count ceiling, documented in the test.
4. Skips nothing; no network; Windows-safe paths.

Docs/tests-only work in Codex's lane. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL), offline, Windows-safe paths. Check `tests/codex/`, `tests/grok/` and in-house `tests/test_*.py` first; don't duplicate a guard.
